title: CCX / API
description: CCX REST (rest-user / rest-admin) and gRPC API traffic, errors and latency.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Total REST request rate for the selected environment, app and path.

panels.title: 5xx %
panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status code.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: 4xx %
panels.description: Share of responses with a 4xx status code (client errors, incl. auth failures).

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration from the request_duration_seconds histogram.

panels.title: Requests/s by app
panels.description: REST request rate per service.

panels.title: Requests/s by status class
panels.description: REST request rate grouped by status class (2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx).

panels.title: Error % by app
panels.description: Share of 4xx and 5xx responses per service, shown separately.

targets.expr: (sum by (app) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (app) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / (sum by (app) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum by (app) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (app) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / (sum by (app) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Request duration percentiles over all selected requests (request_duration_seconds histogram).

panels.title: p95 latency by app
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration per service.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (app, le) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of request durations per histogram bucket over time.

panels.title: Top 10 slowest paths (p95)
panels.description: Paths with the highest 95th percentile duration over the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (app, method, path, le) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range]))) > 0)

sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range])) and on (app, method, path) topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (app, method, path, le) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Top paths by error rate
panels.description: Paths with the highest share of 4xx+5xx responses over the selected time range, with the 5xx share and request rate.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"[45].."}[$__range])) / (sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range])) > 0))

((sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range])) * 0) / (sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range])) > 0)) and on (app, method, path) topk(10, sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"[45].."}[$__range])) / (sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range])) > 0))

sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range])) and on (app, method, path) topk(10, sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path", code=~"[45].."}[$__range])) / (sum by (app, method, path) (rate(requests_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", app=~"$app", path=~"$path"}[$__range])) > 0))

panels.title: Average request / response size
panels.description: Mean HTTP body size per request; request_size_bytes and response_size_bytes are summaries without quantiles and without a path label, so only averages per app are available (path filter not applied).

panels.title: Request / response throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second received in request bodies and sent in response bodies per app (path filter not applied).

panels.title: gRPC latency

options.content: gRPC **latency is not available** yet: the go-grpc-prometheus handling-time histogram (`grpc_server_handling_seconds`) is disabled. It appears once the ccx-backend stores, users, billing and hook gRPC servers call `grpc_prometheus.EnableHandlingTimeHistogram()` / `WithServerHandlingTimeHistogram`. The panels below use counters only and are filtered by environment (the app/path variables only apply to HTTP).

panels.description: Explains why gRPC latency panels are missing.

panels.title: gRPC handled/s by service
panels.description: Completed gRPC calls per second per service.

panels.title: gRPC handled/s by code
panels.description: Completed gRPC calls per second per status code.

panels.title: gRPC error % by service
panels.description: Share of gRPC calls finishing with a code other than OK, per service.

targets.expr: (sum by (grpc_service) (rate(grpc_server_handled_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", grpc_code!="OK"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (grpc_service) (rate(grpc_server_handled_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / (sum by (grpc_service) (rate(grpc_server_handled_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: gRPC started vs handled
panels.description: Calls started vs completed per second; a persistent gap means calls are hanging.

panels.title: gRPC messages sent / received
panels.description: Stream messages sent and received per second per service.

panels.title: Top gRPC methods by errors
panels.description: gRPC methods with the most non-OK responses over the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (grpc_service, grpc_method, grpc_code) (increase(grpc_server_handled_total{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", grpc_code!="OK"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Requests/s by HTTP code (requests_count)
panels.description: Request rate from the legacy rest/handlers Stats middleware (requests_count{http_code}); on live only ccx-auth-service serves traffic through it, which requests_total does not cover.

panels.title: Average latency (request_latency)
panels.description: Mean request duration from the legacy request_latency summary (observed in microseconds, converted to seconds); no quantiles are exported, and it is empty when the auth service saw no requests in the window.

list.name: path
list.label: Path
list.description: Route template (applies to HTTP panels with a path label).
